description: The root of a complaint investigation under 21 CFR 211.198: one case record that every piece of evidence hangs off as a delegated child, closed by a distinct QA investigator's verdict. The QA investigator (principal, a named human) opens it naming the case orchestrator (performer); the orchestrator fans the reads out as calder-evidence-read-v1 children, one per automation per dataset, each engine-gated on the read-only invariant. The case is read-only by declaration (readOnly const true) and by construction: no child touches a system of record, and a child that reports a mutation fails its own gate and so fails the case by rollup. The orchestrator's completion is admitted only once every child is terminal; it carries the conclusion, the investigation summary hash, the CAPA and reportability decisions with their conditional fields, and a digest of the source records' write stamps re-read at close. The QA verdict (accept) closes the case; its checks object carries the signature meaning. The engine rule here is advisory only (principal mode): the human decides.

complaintId.description: The complaint identifier in the quality system.

productCode.description: Product code as the ERP/MES names it.

lotNumbers.description: Lot or batch numbers the complaint names.

descriptionHash.description: sha256 of the complaint text as received (the text itself stays in the quality system).

distributed.description: Whether the named lots were distributed (drives reportability).

readOnly.description: Declares the investigation touches no system of record. Every evidence child's gate enforces it.

openedBy.description: Display name of the QA investigator who opened the case.

investigationPerformed.description: Whether an investigation under 211.192 was performed (211.198(b)).

noInvestigationReason.description: Required when investigationPerformed is false: the written reason, and the name of the responsible person who made the determination (211.198(b)(3)).

evidenceRecordIds.description: The calder-evidence-read-v1 child record ids this conclusion rests on.

summaryHash.description: sha256 of the written investigation summary held in the quality system.

capaRef.description: Required when capaRequired: the CAPA identifier in the quality system.

reportable.description: Whether the finding is reportable to a regulator (e.g. a Field Alert Report under 21 CFR 314.81(b)(1)).

reportDueBy.description: Required when reportable: the regulatory deadline (FAR: 3 working days from receipt).

sorRecordsUnchanged.description: Whether every source record the children read carries the same write stamp at close as it did when read.

sorWriteStampDigest.description: sha256 over the sorted (model, id, writeDate) tuples of every source record re-read at close. An auditor re-derives it from the children's evidence.
